name: Trout & Ries Positioning & Category Law
diagnostic: What single word, category rung, or pre-existing cognitive bias does our brand own to the exclusion of all competitors?
artifact: A Category Ladder Ledger detailing: the Top-of-Mind Category Leader, the Antithetical Second-Rung Position (the "un-leader"), and a Singular Word Association Register.
trap: Diluting a focused mental position by stretching the brand name across unrelated market segments and products.
pedigreeFull: Al Ries & Jack Trout (*Positioning: The Battle for Your Mind*, 1981). The foundational media-era advertising framework that defines positioning as the cognitive ownership of a singular idea in the mind of the prospect.
